Multi-scale engineering of biodegradable Zn-Mg interbody cages for stronger, faster spinal fusion.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Zihuan Yang, Jiang Sun, Chengcong Huang, Yageng Li, Shanshan Liu et al. Biomaterials 2026-08-10 10.1016/j.biomaterials.2026.124538
单位: Department of Orthopedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, 100191, China; Engineering Research Center of Bone and Joint Precision Medicine, Department of Orthopedics, Beijing, 100191, China
通讯: Yageng Li @ Beijing Key Laboratory of Materials Intelligent Technology, School of Advanced Materials Innovation, State Key Laborator  |  Luning Wang @ Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Materials Genome Engineering, School of Materials Science and Engineering, Univer  |  Weishi Li @ Department of Orthopedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, 100191, China; Engineering Research Center of Bone
相关性: 该论文直接涉及增材制造生物医用植入物（Zn-Mg椎间融合器）的力学性能、骨整合和动物实验验证，与AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
边界: 该论文未涉及应力遮挡或刚度匹配的定量分析，也未报告疲劳性能或表面粗糙度/成形形态，且未针对髋关节植入物。
动机· 现有脊柱融合器难以兼顾承重与骨整合，需开发新型可降解植入物。
方法· 采用增材制造制备Zn-Mg合金多尺度结构（共晶、异质晶粒、陀螺晶格加肋），并进行体外与体内评估。
结果· Zn-Mg融合器具有类皮质骨抗压强度、低弹性模量，促进成骨分化，并在羊模型中实现快速骨整合和稳定。
验证· 通过体外细胞实验和羊ACDF模型24周体内降解实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Current spinal fusion cages often fail to simultaneously provide adequate mechanical support and seamless bone integration, necessitating novel biodegradable implant designs.
Method· The authors fabricated Zn-Mg interbody cages via additive manufacturing with multi-scale structural control, including eutectic microstructure, heterogeneous grain architecture, and gyroid lattices reinforced by interpenetrating ribs, and evaluated their biological and mechanical performance.
Result· The Zn-Mg cages exhibited compressive strength comparable to cortical bone, low elastic modulus, enhanced osteogenic differentiation in vitro, and excellent biocompatibility with rapid osseointegration and maintained intervertebral stability in an ovine ACDF model over 24 weeks.
Validation· Validation included in vitro cell assays and an in vivo sheep anterior cervical discectomy and fusion model with 24-week follow-up.

A Comprehensive Framework for Design and Optimization of Graded Metamaterials Subjected to Concentrated Bandwidth Excitations

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
J. Pereira, Rafael O. Ruiz Journal of Engineering Mechanics 2026-07-30 10.1061/jenmdt.emeng-8960
单位: Univ. of Michigan–Dearborn
相关性: 该论文提出的基于代理模型和贝叶斯优化的框架可迁移至植入物有限元代理建模与设计优化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物验证。
边界: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics applications, lacks experimental validation, and focuses on metamaterial vibration rather than stress shielding or bone-implant interface mechanics.
动机· 高效设计受随机激励的梯度超材料，降低高保真有限元计算成本。
方法· 集成多区域Craig-Bampton降阶、PCA/kriging代理、状态空间激励模型和贝叶斯优化。
结果· 代理模型准确预测随机性能，发现性能与计算成本权衡，最优设计依赖激励带宽。
验证· 在二维超材料数值案例中验证代理模型精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To efficiently design graded mechanical metamaterials under finite-bandwidth stochastic excitations by overcoming high computational cost and high-dimensional design spaces.
Method· The framework integrates a multiregion Craig-Bampton component mode synthesis with PCA/kriging surrogate for reduced-order matrices, a state-space stochastic excitation model solved via Lyapunov equation, and Bayesian optimization over low-dimensional grading parameters.
Result· The surrogate accurately predicts stochastic performance, revealing a trade-off between performance and computational cost, and showing that optimal grading depends on excitation bandwidth.
Validation· Validation is performed through a numerical benchmark on a 2D metamaterial, comparing surrogate predictions against high-fidelity FE results.

NURBS-based explicit triply periodic minimal surfaces reconstruction for porous design and isogeometric analysis

Jiayi Li, Zhaoyun Liu, Shengxue Wang, Xiaoxiao Du, Gang Zhao Materials & Design 2026-07-30 10.1016/j.matdes.2026.116688
单位: School of Mechanical Engineering and Automation, Beihang University, Beijing 100191, China
通讯: Xiaoxiao Du @ Key Laboratory of Digital and Intelligent Manufacturing Technology for Aviation Equipment, Ministry of Industry and Info  |  Gang Zhao @ Key Laboratory of Digital and Intelligent Manufacturing Technology for Aviation Equipment, Ministry of Industry and Info
相关性: 该论文提出了一种基于NURBS的TPMS多孔结构显式建模与等几何分析方法，虽未涉及生物医学植入物或力学验证，但其建模与逆设计方法可迁移至骨科植入物多孔结构的设计与仿真。
边界: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or any biomedical context such as stress shielding or osseointegration.
动机· TPMS结构拓扑复杂且隐式表示难以集成CAD/CAE，需显式建模方法。
方法· 提出基于NURBS的TPMS重建框架，通过约束拟合、Bézier映射和偏移曲面生成样条实体。
结果· 实现了四种TPMS的显式建模，建立了偏移距离与水平集常数的二次关系，并支持逆设计。
验证· 通过重建误差和连续性分析验证模型精度与光滑性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The complex topology and implicit representation of triply periodic minimal surface structures hinder their integration with conventional CAD/CAE systems, necessitating an explicit modeling approach.
Method· A unified NURBS-based reconstruction framework is proposed, employing constrained fitting, Bézier mapping with continuity enforcement, and offset surface generation to create trivariate spline solids.
Result· The framework successfully models four TPMS types, establishes a quadratic relationship between offset distance and level-set constant for thickness control, and enables inverse design for target properties.
Validation· The accuracy and smoothness of the generated models are validated through quantitative reconstruction-error evaluation and continuity analysis.

单位: University of Antananarivo, Madagascar
相关性: 该论文将PINN与扩展卡尔曼滤波结合用于湍流重建，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化与数据同化。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical implants, lacks contact mechanics or implant-specific constraints, and does not validate on any biomechanical or structural mechanics problem.
动机· 提升PINN在稀疏或分布外数据下的湍流重建精度。
方法· 将PINN与扩展卡尔曼滤波结合，进行顺序空间校正并自适应调整噪声协方差。
结果· 相比单独PINN，MSE降低46.6%至51.2%，平均改善49.1%。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural network reconstructions of turbulent statistics when data are sparse or out-of-distribution.
Method· A hybrid framework couples a PINN parameterized by friction Reynolds number with an extended Kalman filter that performs sequential spatial corrections with adaptive noise covariance tuning.
Result· The PINN+EKF approach reduces mean squared error by 46.6% to 51.2% across Reynolds numbers compared to the standalone PINN, with a mean improvement of 49.1%.
Validation· The model is trained on DNS data at Re_tau=5200 and evaluated without retraining on multiple Reynolds numbers (550, 2000, 5200, 10000).

相关性: 该论文研究了增材制造TPMS结构的动态力学性能，虽面向航空航天，但其方法可迁移至生物医用植入物的力学评估。
边界: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses on aerospace/automotive applications with Inconel 718, not biocompatible materials.
动机· 研究TPMS结构在动态载荷下的力学性能，弥补准静态研究的不足。
方法· 采用LPBF制造In718 TPMS，进行多步热处理，并开展准静态和动态冲击测试。

Motivation· This study addresses the lack of dynamic loading performance data for additively manufactured TPMS structures, which are typically evaluated under quasi-static conditions.
Method· Inconel 718 TPMS samples were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion, subjected to a multi-step heat treatment, and then tested under quasi-static and dynamic impact loading at various velocities.
Result· Heat treatment improved the microstructure by dissolving detrimental phases and precipitating strengthening phases, leading to significantly enhanced mechanical properties under dynamic loading, with the diamond TPMS elastic modulus increasing by up to 541% and energy absorption nearly doubling.
Validation· The findings were validated through scanning electron microscopy for microstructural analysis and mechanical testing using a universal testing machine.

Motivation· Physics-informed neural networks struggle with discontinuous solutions of hyperbolic conservation laws, often requiring strong priors or artificial smoothing that degrade accuracy.
Method· The proposed Weak-Entropy PINN enforces the governing equations in weak integral form, incorporates the entropy condition to select physically admissible solutions, and uses discrete fast Fourier transform for efficient numerical integration.
Result· Extensive numerical experiments on scalar and systems of conservation laws in 1D and 2D demonstrate accurate resolution of sharp discontinuities and capture of shock-rarefaction interactions.
Validation· The method is validated through numerical benchmarks on standard hyperbolic conservation law problems, comparing with existing PINN variants.

Motivation· To mitigate the clinical risks of forced predictions in ambiguous cases, this work introduces a quantum-inspired multiple instance learning framework with a double-verification triage mechanism.

Motivation· The paper addresses the challenge of optimizing pretrained world models for user-specified objectives, where strategies rarely transfer across models without validation.
Method· VERDI constructs optimization fingerprints via shared probes, retrieves prior experience as ranked hypotheses, and validates candidates under a frozen verifier before admitting them as reusable evidence.
Result· Experiments show VERDI reduces search cost by 68%, GPU cost by 69%, and negative transfer from 0.34 to 0.06, with 83% sign accuracy in predicting transfer outcomes.
Validation· The method is validated on Ctrl-World, Cosmos family, and RoboCoin benchmarks.

Motivation· To address the challenge of online quality control in laser powder bed fusion where key quality indicators like overhang dross cannot be directly measured during the build.
Method· A neuro-symbolic closed-loop architecture is introduced, where a standards-aligned ontology reasons over process constraints and objectives to set references and bounds for a constraint-aware predictive controller, with a Gaussian process providing calibrated uncertainty for the mapping from observable melt pool width to unobservable depth.
Result· The architecture eliminates dross produced by a geometry-blind controller, maintains zero dross with only minor lack-of-fusion under dual scoring, and degrades gracefully under deliberate plant mismatch.

Motivation· Local validation in scientific machine learning cannot guarantee that explanations assemble into a globally coherent account, motivating a computable audit framework.
Method· SEAM introduces a generator-agnostic framework that represents regions as structured explanations with state, closure, and observation channels, and detects inconsistencies via channel-resolved obstructions.
Result· Across synthetic PDE systems and out-of-distribution FNO monitoring, SEAM identifies incompatible explanations even when local predictions are accurate, attributing failures to specific channels and overlaps.
Validation· The framework is validated through nineteen numerical experiments on synthetic PDE systems and FNO monitoring, demonstrating its ability to detect global inconsistencies.
